summary: Complaints centre on delayed sugarcane dues, erratic power, a municipal sanitation and tax dispute, waterlogging from poorly cleaned drains and a dilapidated Bhainsi nala bridge, while the strongest positives are the Triveni sugar mill and NH-58 trade links.

round2.changes: Removed The Wire (headline only, body could not be opened). Replaced negative 1 with a sourced Muzaffarnagar cane-dues item (Royal Bulletin, 8 Oct 2026) because the Wire item was dropped and the district-level cane item is now sourced. Added Patrika 5 Nov 2025 Khatauli rajwaha item (silt left, waterlogging) as negative 5, replacing the inference. Corrected negative 4 wording to match the Amar Ujala text (hundreds of villagers and vehicles cross daily; iron girders). Shortened all Hindi statements to 10-13 words (positive 1 was 17). Power negative kept as an aggregator item (Ground News summarising Dainik Bhaskar) because the Bhaskar original could not be fetched. Confirmed Wikipedia facts for all five positives and the identity (constituency 15, reserved None, Muzaffarnagar). Corrected Patrika dates from the printed timestamps (5 May 2026 and 5 Nov 2025). Zero inference items remain.

positives.english: Our Triveni sugar mill is the largest in Asia
positives.hindi: हमारी त्रिवेणी चीनी मिल एशिया में सबसे बड़ी है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: Khatauli's Triveni sugar mill is 'the largest in Asia in terms of production and storage capacity', operating since 1933. This is a source fact, not a voter quote.

positives.english: We benefit from NH-58, an important route for trade
positives.hindi: हमें हाईवे-58 का फायदा मिलता है, व्यापार का अहम रास्ता है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: 'Khatauli lies on the National Highway 58 which is an important route for trade and commerce.' Recorded as a fact, not a voiced appreciation.

positives.english: The 8.3 km Khatauli-Jeevna road is being built
positives.hindi: खतौली से जीवना तक 8.3 किमी सड़क बन रही है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, dateline Khatauli), 10 Nov 2022, verified: PWD XEN Neeraj Kumar said the road is 8.3 km, costs Rs 436.53 crore and runs from Khatauli to Jeevana. This is a 2022 report; current completion status was not found.

positives.english: Trains to Delhi and Saharanpur are available from Khatauli
positives.hindi: खतौली से दिल्ली-सहारनपुर की रेल मिल जाती है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: 'The town lies on Delhi - Saharanpur (via Meerut) railway route.' Recorded as a fact, not a voiced appreciation.

positives.english: Khatauli has been a tehsil since 2007 and is about 100 km from Delhi
positives.hindi: खतौली 2007 से तहसील है, दिल्ली से लगभग 100 किलोमीटर दूर
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: 'Khatauli was declared as Tehsil in 2007'; 'situated 100 km away from the national capital New Delhi'. Recorded as a fact; weakest positive, no voter appreciation found.

negatives.english: Cane dues remain unpaid and farmers want the mills to pay quickly
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का बकाया भुगतान अटका है, मिलें जल्द पैसा दें
negatives.basis: Royal Bulletin (Muzaffarnagar), 8 Oct 2026, verified: farmers of the BKU protested at the IPL sugar mill, Rohana Kalan, Muzaffarnagar, demanding that outstanding cane payment be made 'without delay' and late-payment interest be paid. No amount is stated. District-level: the mill is not in Khatauli and Khatauli is not named.

negatives.english: Power vanishes for hours, coming back only for a few minutes at a time
negatives.hindi: बिजली घंटों गायब रहती है, कुछ मिनट आकर फिर चली जाती है
negatives.basis: Dainik Bhaskar via Ground News (aggregator), 27 July 2026, verified from the aggregator page: power supply disrupted for nearly a week; 'The supply would come on for a few minutes and then disappear for hours.' District-level (Muzaffarnagar); Khatauli is not named. The original bhaskar.com article could not be opened.

negatives.english: In Khatauli, sanitation workers struck over a tax dispute, and police used lathis
negatives.hindi: खतौली में टैक्स विवाद पर सफाई कर्मी हड़ताल पर, पुलिस ने लाठी चलाई
negatives.basis: Patrika, published and updated 5 May 2026, verified: in the Khatauli nagar palika area, about 50 quintals of garbage were dumped outside a Congress leader's house over about Rs 4 lakh of unpaid tax on four shops; sanitation workers stopped work and announced a strike; police lathi-charged the protesters.

negatives.english: The old bridge over the Bhainsi nala on the Khatauli-Nawala road is dilapidated, yet hundreds of villagers and vehicles cross it daily
negatives.hindi: भैंसी नाले का पुल जर्जर, फिर भी सैकड़ों ग्रामीण और वाहन गुज़रते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala, 10 Nov 2022, verified: the bridge over the Bhainsi nala on the Khatauli-Nawala road is in a dilapidated state and kept in use with iron girders; besides farmers taking cane to the mill, hundreds of villagers and vehicles cross it daily. Road work started while the bridge work was stalled pending a tender. This is a 2022 report; current status was not found.

negatives.english: The distributary was cleaned, but silt was left there, causing waterlogging and a bad smell
negatives.hindi: रजवाहे की सफाई हुई, कीचड़ वहीं छोड़ दिया, जलभराव और बदबू
negatives.basis: Patrika, published 5 Nov 2025, verified: the rajwaha (distributary) was cleaned in Khatauli, but the removed silt and mud were left there, which caused waterlogging and a foul smell. Farmer leader warned of a major agitation if the debris was not removed quickly. Khatauli-specific; the 2025 date is older than preferred, but the issue is local.

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia AC page (Constituency No. 15, Khatauli, Muzaffarnagar, reserved status None). Region set to Paschim UP by assignment because the Wikipedia infobox only says 'North India'. The Wikipedia AC page lists Madan Bhaiya (RLD) as incumbent, elected 2022; it also has a 2027 results section with no vote figures. Political items were excluded per the brief. Round 2 result: three Khatauli-specific negatives (sanitation dispute May 2026, Bhainsi nala bridge 2022, rajwaha waterlogging Nov 2025). Two negatives are district-level (cane dues at Rohana Kalan mill, 8 Oct 2026; power cuts, 27 Jul 2026, via an aggregator). Positives 1, 2, 4 and 5 are Wikipedia facts rather than voter appreciation; positive 3 is a 2022 project report and its completion status is unknown. No Khatauli-specific 2024-2026 positive was found. Searches that found nothing for Khatauli: Triveni Khatauli mill cane dues 2026, NH-58 jams at Khatauli, Khatauli power cut protests, Bhainsi nala bridge completion. The Wire item was dropped because only its headline was available. The Dainik Bhaskar original could not be fetched, so the power item relies on the Ground News summary. Patrika dates were read from printed timestamps; a search snippet listed 27 Jul 2026 for the JE/rajwaha story, but the printed date is 5 Nov 2025 and that is used. Field checks needed: Triveni Khatauli mill dues for the 2025-26 season; current status of the Bhainsi nala bridge and the Khatauli-Jeevna road; NH-58 jams in Khatauli; power-cut hours for Khatauli feeders; whether the May 2026 sanitation tax dispute is resolved. P1, P2 and P4 are reframed from Wikipedia facts into voter speech; no voter quote supports them, so treat them as weak positives. P5 weak positive: tehsil status and distance from Delhi are geography facts with no voter appreciation found.
